mapProfile.thesis: Commit a final Flock build, time Molt precisely, and pay off every route consequence at the citywide chokepoint.
bossPrepHints: Stockpile Cover before the Roost Warden's scripted Heavy Strikes.
Hold Open Sky Guard for the Warden's Skyfall Decree so Molt turns stay safe.
Clear snags fast: the Roost Warden punishes a cluttered draw with nextAttackBonus.

enemies.name: Iron Talon
enemies.lesson: Elite: a High Roost enforcer that walls up before a crushing blow.
enemies.description: A massive eagle enforcer that turns high-roost scaffolds into walls before dropping a crushing blow.
enemies.visualBrief: Large eagle in reinforced urban workwear, heavy talon bands, broad utility straps, and battered metal-panel accents with high scaffold rail styling.
enemies.silhouette: Big blocky raptor with shield-wide shoulders, hooked beak, and planted talons.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Perch Thug
enemies.lesson: Sustained Cover against a relentless basic attacker.
enemies.description: A rough city pigeon bruiser that owns the lower perch and keeps swinging until cover gives out.
enemies.visualBrief: Stocky pigeon in a scuffed zip hoodie, patched chest wrap, concrete-gray talon bands, and rain-grit feathers on a narrow high-roost ledge.
enemies.silhouette: Round compact bruiser with puffed chest and short, stubborn stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and feet, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.description: A knife-fast shrike that rides scaffold wind corridors and torn billboard gaps to break formation discipline.
enemies.visualBrief: Lean shrike in a wind-cut cropped shell, narrow signal strap, white-black feather contrast, reflective talon wraps, and clipped route tabs over a high-roost scaffold gap with torn billboard frame lines.
enemies.silhouette: Small sharp predator with long tail, hooked beak, and slicing diagonal wings.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, long tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.description: A relay falcon that marks the flock with a fast pass, then returns for the heavy strike it already signaled.

enemies.visualBrief: Broad owl in a heavy padded roost vest, quiet hood wrap, utility perch straps, and bright eyes between cracked signal panels.
enemies.silhouette: Wide still watcher with round head, broad wing cloak, and wall-like posture.

enemies.lesson: Elite tempo: trade through winded and a snag while staying covered.
enemies.description: A rival harrier that rides warm rooftop currents, forcing tempo trades through wind, snags, and cover.
enemies.visualBrief: Lean high-roost harrier in layered rust-and-graphite windwear, pale thermal scarf, matte talon bands, clipped route cord, and compact scaffold repair pouch.
enemies.silhouette: Long-winged low-hunting raptor with a narrow head, folded crescent wings, trailing route cord, and alert talon stance.

enemies.lesson: Elite Open Sky bully that bonuses into a heavy when you stay exposed.
enemies.description: A high-status raven that claims the skyline rail and grows more dangerous whenever the flock stays exposed.
enemies.visualBrief: Large raven in dark luxe roostwear, structured rain mantle, subtle chain clips, and talon bands with high skyline perch styling under hard wind.
enemies.silhouette: Tall long-winged corvid with a regal perch stance and cloak-like feather mass.

enemies.name: The Roost Warden
enemies.description: The final guardian of the restored flyway, a huge raptor that binds routes, opens the sky, and tests the whole flock.
enemies.visualBrief: Massive eagle-owl boss in layered final-route workwear, heavy utility harness, worn roost mantle, snagged line accents, and talon bands on the citywide chokepoint tower.
enemies.silhouette: Largest enemy silhouette: broad wings, heavy head, deep talons, and a tower-filling final-boss stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, body angled slightly left or right with face and head aligned to the same 3/4 angle; enemy appears braced, watchful, or ready to act while staying readable; full body visible with natural wings, tail, and talons, standing on an implied ground line with weight supported by natural feet, talons, paws, or webbed feet; avoiding straight-on symmetry, floating poses, and human shoulder posture.

enemies.name: Vulture Cleanup Crew
enemies.lesson: Cleanup pressure: heals if left alone and punishes low Cohesion.
enemies.description: A patient high-roost scavenger posted near roof-access salvage carts, waiting for weakness before closing the cleanup lane.
enemies.visualBrief: Turkey vulture in a worn roost mantle, utility harness, talon bands, subtle salvage tags, and clipped tarp-cord accents beside a roof-access landing and service-cart scrap; natural bare head and wings unobstructed.
enemies.silhouette: Large hunched scavenger bird with bare head, broad wings, and watchful droop.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with mantle following folded wings rather than making human shoulders.

enemies.name: Woodpecker Riveter
enemies.lesson: Riveter: builds Cover and pounds harder when you cannot break it.
enemies.description: A precise signal-yard riveter that pecks loose brackets, stickered panels, and cover points until defenses give way.
enemies.visualBrief: Pileated woodpecker in a cropped utility bib, reflective work sash, tiny stickered rivet pouch, talon bands, and signal-panel repair props clipped to body near scaffold bolts and roofline junction boxes.
enemies.silhouette: Medium bird with tall red crest, chisel beak, stiff tail, and braced pecking posture.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on talons with beak prominent and tools clipped, not hand-held.

enemies.name: Porcupine Bristleguard
enemies.lesson: Bristleguard elite: punishes repeated pressure with guard and Winded.
enemies.description: A bristled defender that makes careless frontal pressure costly while it slowly advances.
enemies.visualBrief: Porcupine in a front-fastened utility harness, bright trim, and flexible pouch straps that leave quills and legs free on concrete.
enemies.silhouette: Round bristling mammal with raised quills, blunt face, and slow guarded stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, natural quadruped posture with quills visible and clothing not covering the defensive silhouette.

enemies.name: Fox Lookout
enemies.lesson: Commander marker: setup turns and Cover pressure diversify High Roost streets.
enemies.description: A distant urban fox that reads the route from shadowed high ground and makes every escort smarter.
enemies.visualBrief: Red fox in a slim reflective collar, fitted shoulder cape lying along the back, and tiny route pouch near rooftop stairwell light.
enemies.silhouette: Lean canid with sharp ears, long muzzle, full tail, and poised observer stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, standing naturally on four paws with cape fitted along the spine and no human coat shoulders.

enemies.name: Peacock Intimidator
enemies.lesson: Morale elite: display pressure turns passive turns into Frail and bigger hits.
enemies.description: A high-status rooftop venue intimidator that uses plumage, posture, and polished streetwear details to make nearby threats look bigger.
enemies.visualBrief: Peacock in a minimalist collar, polished talon cuffs, body-safe decorative clips, route-tag jewelry, and rooftop gala trim, with natural train fully visible and unaltered.
enemies.silhouette: Large bird with dramatic fan train, small head crest, and proud natural stance.
enemies.artPose: Front-facing 3/4 dramatic idle cutout pose, grounded on natural feet with display feathers doing the intimidation, not clothing bulk.

signals.title: Final Chalk Junction
signals.prompt: The last unbound junction is here. Marking it ties the whole flyway together, but the climb out is exposed.

signals.title: Storm Window
signals.prompt: A break in the weather offers a quiet landing, but a rival lookout is watching the approach to the Roost.

signals.title: Last Signal Cache
signals.prompt: A route-runner left a sealed cache wired to the old signal mast. Opening it could arm the flock for the Roost Warden.

signals.title: Wind Breach
signals.prompt: A sudden updraft tears through your formation, scattering the flock. Some birds climb the current; others tumble down into the gutters.

choices.text: Ride the updraft toward the peak.
Drop into the shelter of the gutters.
Let the wind scatter you — maybe it finds loot.

signals.title: Caught in Line
signals.prompt: Tangled fishing line drapes across the thermal. Unwinding it costs time and feathers, but the line itself might be useful.

choices.text: Cut loose and run for cover.

signals.title: Molt Window
signals.prompt: The air currents say you could Molt here — shed the old feathers, refresh the draw. But it is risky so close to the summit.

choices.text: Bank your strength for the climb.

signals.title: Rival Perch Lookout
signals.prompt: A rival flock has claimed the high perch overlooking your route. They are watching the approach to the Warden's nest.

signals.title: Storm's Lull
signals.prompt: The storm pauses. Rain stops. The sky is perfectly still — too still. In these rare moments, the flock can rest or scavenge before the next front rolls in.

choices.text: Preen a card while you can.

signals.title: Warden's Summons Echoes
signals.prompt: A distant cry echoes down from the Warden's tower. The flock feels it — the final challenge is calling. You can answer now or gather your strength for the climb.
